name: cursor-pagination
prompt: Offset paging over orders is slow and skips rows when orders are added while a client pages. Change listOrders in src/db/orders.js from listOrders(offset, limit) to cursor paging: listOrders({ after, limit = 50 }) returns { items, nextCursor }, where items are the orders with an id greater than `after` (all orders when after is undefined) in ascending id order, at most `limit` of them, and nextCursor is the id of the last returned item, or null when there are no more orders after it. Update every caller in the project to the new API.
